quests.title: The Sorcerer King
quests.about: Ainz is the last of his guild, and he's been trying to decide whether the people in town are real. He wears a ring he won't take off, and he asks strangers about a name they never say.
offer: them (pleased): Greetings. I am the Sorcerer King, and you will answer a question for me, honestly.

quests.title: The Beater
quests.about: Kirito wears a black coat and carries two blades, and he calls himself a beater. He came from another game and still thinks of the town as one, and he's hiding the reason why.

endings.title: Learn the beater's name
endings.about: Kirito tells you his real name, Kazuto. Beater was the name he used in the game, and Kazuto is the one he's been hiding behind it. He asks you to call him by it when nobody else is listening.

quests.title: The Game
quests.about: Kirito is still playing the game he came from, in a town that doesn't know it's a game. Ainz is the only other player he's found, and Kirito wants to know whether Ainz is a threat to the town.
offer: them (dismayed): There's a Sorcerer King here who calls himself a player. I need to know if he's dangerous.

endings.about: Kirito keeps playing, and says the game is still worth it, as long as he's not alone in it. He asks you to be the one who checks his blades every morning.

quests.title: Crusader Duty
quests.about: Darkness is a crusader who guards the town's gate, and she is delighted to be hurt in the line of duty. She'd like someone to come and watch her take a hit, for the sake of the town.
offer: them (pleased): I'm on the gate tonight. Come and watch me take a hit for the town, if you can bear it.
them: Meet me at the shrine at noon. The shield needs polishing, and I'd like a second pair of eyes on the dents.

Tell Darkness what you thought of the dents

script: them (pleased): You looked at the dents, and didn't flinch at the ones I've taken for the town. Wonderful.

endings.title: Hold the shield
endings.about: Darkness hands you the shield for a moment, and says it's heavier than it looks. She asks you to hold it while she goes to the gate, and to be there when she gets back.

quests.title: The Masochist
quests.about: Megumin has challenged Darkness to a duel, and she's sure she'll win with her one explosion spell. Darkness wants to be the one who loses, for the sake of the lesson, and she needs you to stand where the blast lands.
offer: them (pleased): Megumin wants to duel me with her explosion. I'm going to let her win, or at least try.
them (dismayed): Stand at the arena's edge, please. If the blast comes, I'd like someone to see me get up.

stages.text: Stand with Darkness at the arena in the evening
Fight Megumin, so Darkness can take the blast
Tell Darkness what Megumin did

script: them (pleased): She blasted me, and I got up. It's the best thing that's happened to me this week.
them (dismayed): She says I'm a masochist. She's right, and I'd like her to know I'm grateful.

endings.title: Take the blast
endings.about: Darkness takes the blast and gets back up, grinning. Megumin's last spell has been spent, and she sulks in the arena, already planning her next crater.

quests.title: The Shield
quests.about: Erza has come to the gate, and she wants the shield for the town's defence. Darkness has to decide whether to give it up, or to fight Erza for the right to keep it.
offer: them (dismayed): Erza's asked for my shield. She says it should go to someone who can hold the line for real.
them: Come to the gate tonight. I want to see whether she's the one who should take the hits, or whether I should.

stages.text: Stand guard with Darkness at the gate at night
Fight Erza, to see who holds the line
Tell Darkness your answer

endings.title: Keep the shield
endings.about: Darkness keeps the shield and holds the gate alone, taking every hit she can. The town has chosen its guardian, and Erza goes back to the training yard, frowning.

endings.title: Share the shield
endings.about: Darkness gives Erza half of the shield, and they hold the gate together. Erza takes the other half of the hits, and grins about it.

quests.title: Ur's Lesson
quests.about: Gray keeps a frozen cup on the windowsill, and he says it's the first thing his teacher Ur ever made. He practises ice-make in the plaza, and his shirt keeps coming off, because Ur always told him ice needs a memory, not a grip.
offer: them: I've got a cup from my teacher. It's made of ice and it hasn't melted in years. Want to see?
them (dismayed): Meet me at the plaza at noon. I'll make ice the way Ur taught me, and you tell me whether it's a memory or a trick.

Tell Gray whether the ice was a memory or a trick

endings.title: Keep Ur's cup
endings.about: Gray gives you the frozen cup to keep. It's cold in your hand, and he asks you to remember the first thing Ur taught him, even if the ice melts.
endings.scene: World: Gray Fullbuster, Ur's Cup Given

quests.title: Deliora's Ice
quests.about: Gray has found a sheet of ice in the old arena cellar that wasn't made by him. It's Ur's Iced Shell, the spell that sealed the monster Deliora, and the ice is starting to crack. Lyon, Ur's other student, is away, so Gray wants another mage's read on the ice. Erza has a steady hand, and she's willing to fight to test his resolve.
offer: them (dismayed): The ice in the cellar is Ur's Iced Shell. It's cracking, and I'm the only one who can hold it.
them: Meet me at the arena in the evening. Lyon's away, and I need another mage to test whether I can hold the shell.

endings.title: Hold the shell
endings.about: Gray holds the cracking shell together with his own ice, and it stops cracking. He says Ur did the same, and that holding a seal is a kind of promise you keep with your whole body.

quests.title: Ur's Sacrifice
quests.about: Gray finally learns what Ur's sacrifice meant. She gave her life to seal Deliora, and the seal is failing now because the cost was never paid in full. Gray has to decide whether to hold the seal alone, or to let it go, the way Ur did.
